column1: # Known accuracy gaps of the textbook suite (physx-bridge/tests/textbook), recorded
# with the error measured when listed (2026-10-07, garage-roof for runtime and
# section-bending, garage-multihull for high-fidelity(no-impact)). A listed check
# that misses the 1% tolerance is KNOWN-GAP; it FAILs again (GAP-WORSE) above
# 1.25x this error + 0.5%; one that passes is FIXED and should be removed here.
# Never raise a number here to make a run pass: a worse error is a regression.
# Causes: MODEL (the stage's model differs from the textbook; the stage matches its
# own model), DISCRETISATION (the chunking), MODEL LIMIT (not representable),
# STAGE (the GPU solve differs from its own model).
